entries.summary: Four industry research programmes added and the crawler now audits pharma coverage itself, because these programmes carry no deadline and come and go.
details: eisai-investigator-initiated-studies added: breast cancer is a named Eisai IIS therapeutic area; rolling submission, oncology proposals reviewed quarterly.

exact-sciences-research-grants added: areas of interest name Oncotype DX in early-stage HR-positive breast cancer; the page currently states 'There are no active RFPs', which is the sentinel the crawler watches.

agendia-flex-registry-substudies added: the FLEX registry (NCT03053193) takes investigator-initiated sub-studies against MammaPrint, BluePrint and full-transcriptome data linked to clinical outcomes; site membership is the gate, not rank.
bms-independent-research-isr added: BMS has moved from rolling submission to periodic RFPs and will post dates and areas of interest on the page when a call opens.

tools/watch.py now carries a 27-company pharma and diagnostics watchlist and raises a coverage_gap signal for any company no record cites, at most once every 30 days, so a programme that appears is not missed.
A rolling portal returning 404 or 410 now raises a distinct not_found signal; three consecutive runs is the retirement trigger for an industry programme, which has no closing date to observe.

entries.summary: Industry portals are now watched daily; Merck's sac-TMT investigator-initiated studies call (proposals due 2026-11-30) recorded from the primary page.
details: merck-misp-sac-tmt-iisp-2026 added: Merck MISP is accepting sac-TMT (MK-2870, TROP2 ADC) investigator-initiated proposals with breast areas of interest; due 2026-11-30, decisions April 2027.

merck-investigator-studies-program: solid-tumor areas of interest read on the primary page; belzutifan, calderasib and sac-TMT actively accepting; watch_urls added so the compound list is diffed daily.
Gilead oncology RFP page read in the browser: 'No current opportunities' under both RFP Programs and RFP Topics of Interest; that sentence is now the watched sentinel.
PCORI Cycle 3 2026 and Fall 2026 dates re-read after the pages became reachable; all three held records unchanged.

entries.summary: DOD BCRP FY26 Breakthrough L1/L2 and Clinical Research Extension dates confirmed on the CDMRP page and Grants.gov; both move from projected to verified.
details: dod-bcrp-breakthrough-l1-l2-fy26-round2: confidence projected to verified; CDMRP page updated 2026-09-03 now lists LOI 2026-11-04 and application 2026-11-18, previously inferred from the pre-announcement

dod-bcrp-clinical-research-extension-fy26-round2: confidence projected to verified; CDMRP page updated 2026-09-03 now lists LOI 2026-11-04 and application 2026-11-18, previously inferred from the pre-announcement
Found by the first run of the deterministic daily watcher (tools/watch.py), which reads the CDMRP page and the Grants.gov API without a model.

entries.summary: Published to GitHub Pages. Front-end defects corrected and four records fixed against the refresh rules.
details: cprit-rft: track_gate 'requires NON-tenure-track' cleared; the RFA recruits tenure-track faculty and the record is ruled out on rank, so the gate banner stated the inverse of the truth.
nih-rse-r50: next_deadline 2026-12-04 to 2026-11-04, its required LOI date, which had overstated lead time by 30 days.
conquer-cancer-yia-special-competitions: loi_deadline set to 2027-01-28, the first-wave RFP date next_deadline already pointed at but no dated field held.
hope-funds-postdoctoral-fellowship: url moved from http to https.
Site: the timeline month filter could not be cleared, so a later search could return zero rows with nothing explaining why; all active filters are now removable tokens.
Site: clicking the Program column header threw a TypeError and left the table unsorted.
Site: day counts drifted by one after local noon, moving three records into the wrong urgency tile.
Site: the timeline window was pinned to Sep 2026 - Oct 2027 and now tracks the current month.
Five mechanisms remain entered twice, once as a standing program and once as a posted cycle; see the reconciliation task in REFRESH.md.

entries.summary: Initial build. 228 mechanisms compiled across six funder buckets from sponsor pages, program announcement PDFs, and Grants.gov.
details: DOD BCRP Breakthrough L3/L4 marked gated: pre-application closed 2026-06-12.
BCRP Breakthrough L1/L2 and Clinical Research Extension downgraded to projected, dates unconfirmed.
FY27 BCRP not appropriated, no dates exist.
CPRIT FY2027 Cycle 2 confirmed directly from cprit.texas.gov, all due 2026-11-18.
NCI no longer publishes paylines; NIH Unified Funding Strategy replaced them January 2026.
